behavior: Orbital rocket is available and does not require a generic aim vector.
TrySetOrbitalTarget records only an unconfirmed player marker; changing intent can call ClearOrbitalTarget and timer expiry clears it.
Fire confirmation consumes ammo, ends the player's turn, and records a deferred strike.
When the opponent turn ends, a vertical projectile is spawned above the marked point and its impact does not consume the new player turn.
design: BattleSimulation owns pending strike state and projectile lifecycle. SimProjectile carries the narrow suppress-turn-advance flag because only deferred system impacts must preserve the already-open turn.
